free_tier.stated: No free sandbox allowance is stated. Workspaces are prepaid by card and requests return 402 at zero balance; the default is 3 running sandboxes before the first paid top-up.
free_tier.notes: No free trial, free credits or recurring free sandbox hours are published on the sandbox, billing or FAQ pages read.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a sandbox, not an object

retention.stated: A running sandbox is stopped at a 24-hour lifetime from creation or last resume; a paused sandbox holds files, memory and processes until deletion or expiry after 30 days.

egress.terms: Outbound internet is enabled by default; port 25 is always blocked. Public preview-port URLs are available with an optional token. No data-out price or allowance is published.

interface_detail: Sandbox API at https://sandbox.keln.ai/v1 with commands, streamed output, file I/O, preview ports and a network policy; an MCP server connects Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.
tooling: The user calls the REST API or connects the hosted MCP server; no client install is needed beyond an API key.
chaining: Sandboxes share the same prepaid balance and API key as Keln inference, so agent compute and model tokens are billed through one account.

limits.value: 100 running sandboxes per workspace, or 3 before the first paid top-up
24-hour sandbox lifetime from creation or last resume; paused sandboxes kept at most 30 days
500 requests per second, burst to 1,000, per key
1 MB request body; file uploads stream and have no limit

limits_note: A balance must cover the first 5 minutes of runtime at create or resume; images are limited to 20 per workspace and previews to 256 per sandbox.
binding_note: With no free credits, the prepaid balance and the 3-sandbox pre-top-up cap stop a user before any time limit does.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-in is with Google, GitHub, or email and password; creating an API key requires a verified email address. Sandbox top-ups are by card, USD 5 to USD 5,000, with a 2.9% plus USD 0.30 fee.

reliability_note: If the balance runs out while sandboxes are running, Keln stops them after 60 seconds; paused sandboxes remain paused because they incur no charges.
confidence_note: Sandbox prices, limits and the prepaid card gate are quoted from the vendor's own docs read on 2026-11-25.
